method: Fresh GitHub clone, isolated virtualenv/config/state; existing monitoring binaries reused read-only. Four bounded loops.

loops.scenario: clone -> editable install -> init -> doctor -> invalid config
loops.finding: Unknown TOML key omitted its name; missing workload command mentioned Bash only.
loops.change: Identify the invalid setting and document the TOML command option.

loops.scenario: CPU workload -> bridge -> manifest -> inspect, then change current cluster
loops.finding: Inspect generated a link to the current cluster instead of the run cluster.
loops.change: Persist cluster/observer_node at launch and use that context for the artifact link; old manifests retain fallback.

loops.scenario: synthetic diagnosis -> real Grafana investigation; repeat fixture generation
loops.finding: Existing output raised an unhandled traceback. README used obsolete dashboard labels.
loops.change: Actionable error with artifact preservation; synchronize README names.

loops.scenario: wide/narrow journey -> query coverage -> full regression -> repeated up/down
loops.finding: No additional confirmed P0/P1 issue in the exercised path.

validation.cpu_workload: exit=0, bridge final export=ok, telemetry completeness=complete; cluster switch retains recorded link
validation.regression: Exit code 7, argv quoting, lifecycle ownership, signals, config errors covered by the existing/full CPU test suite.
validation.lifecycle: Repeated up reported already running; repeated down succeeded; final status stopped, no stale PID.

effects.cardinality: No added Prometheus labels or metric/query changes.
effects.performance: No throughput/overhead improvement claimed; change adds two manifest settings, not per-event work.
effects.compatibility: Existing shell lifecycle and run manifest schema version retained.

limitations: Synthetic values and precomputed diagnosis are illustrative; not real VERL training or storage causality validation.
No actual GPU/VERL, Docker cgroup, 3FS, Ollama or physical/VM multi-node rerun.
Monitoring binary download/install was not rerun; pinned existing binaries were reused.
The browser validator initially received node=.* and rejected the deliberate run-row drill-down to gpu-node-0; rerun with the actual resource node passed.
900px detail tables still require horizontal scrolling for all evidence fields; native table behavior retained.
No Loki-disabled browser scenario rerun in this cycle.

cleanup.preserved: Only this compact validation record and source/test/doc changes.
cleanup.pre_existing_services: Grafana, Prometheus, Loki and node exporter still HTTP 200; not restarted.
